title: Check Codex CLI availability
responsibility: Checks the Codex version, ChatGPT sign-in and available model and image-generation capabilities.

inputs.name: codexState.command
inputs.description: The executable name or path and initial arguments used for Codex's version probe. codexState appends --version to args and invokes cliProcess with a 10,000 ms timeout.

inputs.name: codexState.server
inputs.description: The executable name or path and arguments used to start the Codex app-server. This command is passed to codexRpc for the account, model-list and capability requests.

outputs.name: codexState
outputs.description: The promise resolves to Codex's ProviderState, including availability, a nullable trimmed CLI version, model choices and image-generation capability; the model request asks for up to 100 records. If discovery fails or the account is not ChatGPT, it resolves unavailable with a reason, empty models and imageGeneration false rather than rejecting.

errors.name: CodexChatGPTSignInError
errors.description: codexState throws CodexChatGPTSignInError('Sign in to Codex CLI with a ChatGPT subscription.') when account/read does not report type chatgpt. The enclosing catch returns the error message as the unavailable state's reason instead of rejecting.
